status: FROZEN -- design decisions locked before the confirmatory run
gate: DO NOT start the 77-subject replication until the independent Work code audit has returned. No further partial-data, smoke, accuracy, LOSO, model-comparison, normalisation-comparison or ablation run may be executed while acquisition is incomplete.

cohorts.derivation: MACHINE-DERIVED, never hand-edited. Re-run tools/freeze_confirmatory_spec.py at the end of acquisition to refresh the cohort lists; the design block below does not change. The exposed set is parsed from the result-producing run logs and the untouched set is (available Exercise-B subjects) minus (exposed). Reading the logs requires BOM-aware decoding: PowerShell 5.1's '*>' redirection writes UTF-16LE, and a UTF-8 read silently matches nothing, which would report every subject as untouched.

development_exposed.note: these subjects entered a result-producing run (the 22-subject exploratory run and/or the 34-subject smoke runs); their performance has been observed and they can no longer serve as pristine confirmation

untouched_confirmation.note: never entered any result-producing run and must not be inspected for classification performance before the final frozen run; this cohort is the strongest confirmatory evidence

primary_names: Extension of index and middle, flexion of the others
Flexion of ring and little finger, extension of the others
Thumb opposing base of little finger
class_vocabulary.excluded: exercise-C object grasps and exercise-B wrist/forearm movements

representations.policy: all three reported side by side; canonical16 is primary; none is used to select or tune the primary model

representative_posture_extraction.rule: split each labelled repetition into thirds; take the MEDIAN of the central third
representative_posture_extraction.tuning: segmentation boundaries are never tuned per class or per accuracy

classifiers.tuning: no hyperparameter search of any kind

normalization.excluded_by_policy: per-subject normalisation of test subjects (requires subject-specific calibration a deployed decoder would not have)

drift_correction.method: per-subject drift trajectory estimated from REST blocks only (labelled-free), median rest posture per block, offsets relative to the first block, linearly interpolated over normalised session time, subtracted
drift_correction.role: falsification control; the primary result is reported uncorrected

metrics.companion: balanced accuracy (classes are balanced by design)

pre_registration.justification_model: Chosen on methodological grounds only; NO accuracy figure entered this decision. Linear discriminant analysis with Ledoit-Wolf shrinkage (solver='lsqr', shrinkage='auto') is closed-form and deterministic -- no iteration, no random seed, and no hyperparameter to search. The analytic shrinkage estimator is the standard remedy for the small-n / many-features-per-class regime that 6 postures x 6 repetitions x N subjects creates, and it yields a probabilistic decision rule, which matches the question being asked ('is the posture identifiable from these kinematics') rather than 'how well can a flexible model fit'. The other four models (two nearest-centroid variants, logistic regression, random forest) are reported as secondary so that the conclusion does not rest on one inductive bias.
pre_registration.justification_normalization: Chosen on methodological grounds only; NO accuracy figure entered this decision. Train-only z-scoring is used because the 16 canonical channels are heterogeneous in scale (thumb CMC and DIP flexion ranges differ several-fold) and DB9's calibration applies per-subject sensor gains, so a shared-covariance model is scale-sensitive. Statistics are fitted on TRAIN subjects only. Per-subject normalisation of test subjects is EXCLUDED by policy: it would require subject-specific calibration that a deployed decoder would not have. The unnormalised ('raw') variant is retained as a reported control.
pre_registration.decision_rule_used: option A of the research lead's instruction: one primary choice pre-registered on methodological reasoning, because no primary model or normalisation had been formally frozen before the smoke runs. All other combinations are reported without choosing a post-hoc winner, and no accuracy figure from the smoke runs entered this choice.

2_untouched_confirmation.a_train_exposed_test_untouched: PRIMARY CONFIRMATORY: train on the development-exposed cohort, evaluate on the untouched cohort. The untouched subjects are never in training and never inspected beforehand.
2_untouched_confirmation.b_loso_within_untouched: secondary confirmatory: leave-one-subject-out restricted to the untouched cohort

final_evaluation_plan.4_source_held_out: train on two source databases, test on the third
